objections.reason: 'mwanamke aliyejikabidhi kwa dini' is too long and complex for ages 8-12; 'mtawa wa kike' is simple and matches T302/T487.
'mateso' is reserved for suffering (duḥkha, T001); hardship (dka' ba) is 'taabu'.
'kujitesa' means torturing oneself, not hardship; also hard for children. 'mambo magumu' means difficult things.
Same concept 'good of others' as T072, rendered 'wema wa wengine'; keep consistent.
Keeps consistent with viveka/dben pa (T130, proposed 'faragha'); 'upweke' suggests loneliness.
'mafunzo' already renders śikṣā 'training' (T046); śāsana is rendered 'mafundisho ya Buddha' in T523.
Swahili orthography does not use IAST diacritics; other names (T73, T319, T332) are plain Latin; keep consistent.
